Themes.title: Themes
Themes.description: Each theme is a complete set of design tokens: light and dark colours, fields, typography, corners and the site's layout. One theme dresses the site and another the panel, switched in one click.

activated.site: The site now uses this theme.
activated.panel: The panel now uses this theme.

create.title: New theme
create.description: The new theme starts with the tokens of the theme chosen as its base.

remove.title: Delete theme
remove.description: The theme “{name}” will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import theme
import.description: Choose a .json file exported by this panel (or one with the tokens only). It is validated before it becomes a new theme.
import.name: Theme name
import.invalid: The file is not a valid theme: check that it was exported by this panel and not changed.
import.tooLarge: The file is too large to be a theme (64 KB at most).

errors.theme_system: System themes cannot be deleted: duplicate them to create variations.
errors.theme_active: An active theme cannot be deleted. Activate another theme on the site and the panel first.
errors.theme_limit: Theme limit reached. Delete themes you do not use.

Themes.forbidden: Your account may not manage themes.

editor.title: Edit theme
editor.saved: Theme saved. The site and the panel use the new version from the next page opened.
editor.identityHint: How the theme appears in the list.
editor.name: Name
editor.colorsHint: Eight tokens for each scheme. The text over buttons is computed automatically.
editor.fieldsHint: How text inputs, selects and the editor are drawn on the site and the panel.
editor.typographyHint: The headings typeface and that of text and controls, chosen separately.
editor.shapesHint: Corners of cards, buttons and images; the header and the style of news cards.

headerOptions.left: Logo on the left, menu beside it

editor.systemNotice: This is a system theme: your changes apply to it, but it can never be deleted. To keep the original, duplicate it first.
editor.activeNotice: This theme is active on: {surfaces}. Saving shows the change right away.

preview.title: Preview
preview.label: Preview of the site with this theme
preview.headline: Portuguese-language AI model now runs entirely on the phone
preview.subtitle: A compact version works offline and sends no data to any server.
cards: Home router flaw gets a fix
University nanosatellite sends its first images
Agricultural drone startup raises R$80 million

typography.sampleText: The text of articles, menus and buttons uses this typeface.

assets.title: Branding
assets.description: Logos, browser tab icons and the default sharing image. Without its own image, the site uses the identity bundled with the portal.

logo.label: Logo (light scheme)
logo.hint: PNG, JPG or WebP up to 5 MB. Transparent background; resized to at most 720 × 200.

logoDark.label: Logo (dark scheme)
logoDark.hint: The light version of the logo, for dark backgrounds. Without it, the light logo is used in both schemes.

faviconDark.label: Favicon (dark scheme)
faviconDark.hint: For dark browser tabs. Without it, the light favicon is used.

social.label: Sharing image
social.hint: 1200 × 630, used when a page without a photo is shared (social networks, messengers).

assets.drop: Drag an image here or click to choose
assets.removeDescription: The image “{name}” will be deleted and the site will use the default identity again.
assets.metadata: Every image is re-encoded by the server: no metadata of the original file (EXIF, GPS) is kept.

errors.unsupportedType: Upload a PNG, JPG or WebP image.
errors.invalidInput: The image could not be processed.
errors.forbidden: Your account may not change the branding.
errors.unavailable: The upload failed. Please try again.

site.title: Site details
site.description: The portal's name, tagline, description, default language, contact and social profiles. They appear in the header, the footer and search results.

sections.identityHint: The name and the sentences that present the portal.
sections.contactHint: The language of whoever opens the site without choosing, and the e-mail that receives the contact form's notices.
sections.socialHint: Full addresses (https://…) of the portal's profiles; blank, the network does not appear on the site.

site.descriptionHint: Used in search results and when the home page is shared.
site.contactEmailHint: Receives a notice of each message sent through the site.
site.forbidden: Your account may not change the site details.

errors.social_invalid: Check the social profile addresses: each must start with https://.

Branding.forbidden: Your account may not change the branding.
